narration: Mini-Kuzai now documents each validated development step through one controlled publication flow. Scientific work is verified first on GitHub through GOGIT and FINAL-DEV-FLOW. After the final receipt is published, the media pipeline creates a sixty-second vertical video, generates Piper narration, mixes the project soundtrack, and audits the result. The verified video is then published publicly on YouTube. The same media package is prepared for a native LinkedIn video post, while GitHub receives a final media publication linked to the technical record. Documentation is updated only after every publication receipt is checked. One validated development step becomes one technical record, one video, and synchronized public communication across GitHub, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
